name: Dynamic iceLand
description:
A Dynamic Island for GNOME that sits at the top of the screen and springs open on hover.

• Music from any player: cover art, title and artist, real-time audio visualizer (with cava), seek bar you can drag, shuffle and repeat
• Colours that follow the album art
• Volume and brightness pop-ups in place of GNOME's
• Charger, low battery, Bluetooth devices, Caps Lock
• Synced lyrics, from your .lrc files or lrclib.net (the song title, artist and album are sent there; can be turned off)
• Notifications as a small card: app icon, message and sender
• Screen recording timer and download progress, with a side bubble while music plays
• Scroll for volume or tracks; choose what left, double, middle and right click do
• Over 80 settings
